confidence_explanation: The evidence shows a clear pattern of an insider threat (user_08) transitioning from reading files within their department to accessing multiple unauthorized departments and culminating in a high volume of data downloads across various departments over several days.

attack_chain.description: User_08 begins by accessing files within their authorized legal directory.
User_08 begins expanding scope by accessing marketing files outside their department.
User_08 accesses finance files outside their department.
User_08 accesses engineering project files and logs during off-hours.
User_08 continues accessing finance files during off-hours.
User_08 transitions from reading to downloading files across multiple departments (Finance, Marketing, Project Beta, HR, and Sales).
User_08 completes a pattern of cross-departmental data exfiltration by downloading sales agreements.

gaps: Lack of information regarding whether user_08 had any legitimate business reason or tickets for cross-departmental access.
No information on the destination of the downloaded files to confirm external exfiltration.
narrative: User_08, a corporate counsel, exhibited a classic insider threat pattern by gradually expanding their access from the legal department to marketing, finance, engineering, HR, and sales. The activity escalated from simple file reads to a concentrated burst of file downloads across all these departments, indicating premeditated data exfiltration.
